summary: Make local plugins available everywhere via default locations or the plugin-type-specific ANSIBLE_<TYPE>_PLUGINS env var or *_PLUGIN_PATH setting, and verify with ansible-doc -t <type>, which doesn't work for action, filter or test plugins.
questions: How do I tell Ansible where my custom callback or filter plugins are?
What environment variable sets the inventory plugin path?
How can I confirm my local lookup plugin is found?
Why doesn't ansible-doc show my custom filter plugin?

answer_card.title: Load local plugins for all playbooks
answer_card.answer_md:
- Put the plugin in the default location for its type, **or**
- Add the directory to `ANSIBLE_<type>_PLUGINS` (e.g. `ANSIBLE_INVENTORY_PLUGINS`, `ANSIBLE_VARS_PLUGINS`) or the `*_PATH` setting (e.g. `DEFAULT_CALLBACK_PLUGIN_PATH`, `DEFAULT_FILTER_PLUGIN_PATH`, `BECOME_PLUGIN_PATH`).

Check: `ansible-config dump | grep <type>_PATH`. Verify: `ansible-doc -t lookup my_local_lookup_plugin`. `ansible-doc` doesn't work for action, filter or test plugins.
